description: 40 independent review tasks for batch05 bilingual drafts. URL links are lookup leads only, NOT checked evidence. Candidate CEFR tiers are unverified and may be wrong; particularly C1 candidate placements.

english_definition_review.task: Compare original definition and exact sense/POS with a reliable learner dictionary. Record checked page URL, date, quoted CEFR label when available, and disagreements.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese language editor to compare draft gloss against verified English sense, grammar and register.

example_review.task: Verify grammaticality, natural collocation, intended sense and originality; revise where needed.

cefr_review.task: Verify this exact sense and POS at this level; reclassify or quarantine if unsupported. Do not infer level from frequency or first WordNet sense.

audio_review.task: After independent text approval, generate George/Emma British recordings and perform real listening plus physical-device Safari checks.
